answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 150 Country: India Title: Can we use interest money from bank to pay income tax to government? Question: Assalamalaikum Can we use interest money from bank to pay income tax to government? Answer ID: 150 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 718=489/H) It is allowable to pay interest money in income tax. (for details see: Fatawa Mahmoodiah, vol 4) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
